parsed.scene_description: A modern, well-lit interior space resembling a library or co-working area. Wooden arches and shelves contrast with blue-tinted glass walls and glowing vertical light strips. People are seated at tables, working or reading. Bookshelves curve around the room, and potted plants add greenery. The floor is polished and reflective.

objects.label: person sitting at desk
objects.observation: A person in a dark jacket sits at a wooden desk on the left, facing away from the camera. They appear to be working on a laptop. Their posture suggests concentration. The desk is partially obscured by an archway behind them.

objects.label: blue glass wall
objects.observation: A large, translucent blue glass wall dominates the background, featuring vertical glowing light strips. Reflections of interior lights and structures are visible on its surface. It separates the foreground from another area.

objects.label: curved wooden bookshelf
objects.observation: A curved, multi-tiered wooden bookshelf occupies the right side of the frame. Books are arranged on its shelves. A circular light fixture illuminates the top shelf. It appears freestanding but integrated into the room’s design.

objects.label: potted plant
objects.observation: A tall green potted plant stands near the center-left, beside the blue glass wall. It has broad leaves and is housed in a white cylindrical pot. Its base rests directly on the polished floor.

objects.label: person sitting at table
objects.observation: A person wearing a plaid shirt sits at a white table in the mid-ground, facing away from the camera. They appear to be working on a laptop. Their chair is metallic and they are positioned under the blue glass wall’s glow.

objects.label: white table
objects.observation: A round white table is located in the mid-ground, near the blue glass wall. It has a thin metal base and is surrounded by chairs. A person is seated at it, suggesting use for work or study.

objects.label: wooden archway
objects.observation: A wooden archway is visible on the left side, framing part of the scene. It curves inward and appears to lead to another section. Its surface is smooth and matches the adjacent shelving.
